registered_before: tuning, the download of the held-out studies, and any evaluation of the horizontal-speed rule

why.failure: amendment 1 (vertical speed) failed: late swing moves horizontally, so vertical speed does not separate it from stance
why.rule_family: horizontal landmark speed is the standard kinematic criterion for a planted foot
why.known_cost: a sliding stance foot of a generated motion loses contact under this rule, so foot sliding also raises its residual; accepted by the user, reduced by the tie-break below and reported in X4
why.decided_by: user (path 3: fix the contact rule and validate it on new held-out walking before X4 uses E)

rule.contact: a sole landmark (heel: calcn origin, toe: toes origin) is in contact when its height <= its 5th percentile + 3 cm (registered) and its horizontal speed on the 100 Hz filtered trajectory <= v_h
rule.everything_else: unchanged (scaling, IK, 6 Hz filter, NNLS GRF, friction 0.8)
rule.implementation: biomech.dynamics(..., contact_hmax=v_h); the default None keeps the registered rule

development.trials: all With_Arm overground walking trials already exported (registered selection and the amendment-1 held-out set, treadmill trials removed) and the registered jump trials in the amendment-2 scope
development.selection: v_h maximising the median walking V3 (balanced accuracy, 20 N); among values within 0.01 of the maximum the largest is taken (least loss of contact for sliding feet); jump V3 must stay >= 0.85
development.grid_note: grid and tie-break margin 约定，未经推演

heldout.studies: AddBiomechanics studies absent from every With_Arm file used so far (Camargo2021, Santos2017, Tan2021, Tan2022, Wang2023; No_Arm models only); same-named No_Arm studies (Falisse2017, Fregly2012, Han2023, Uhlrich2023, Hamner2013, Tiziana2019, Li2021) are reprocessings of used data and are not held out
heldout.trials: overground level walking identified by trial name only (no treadmill, ramp, stair or transition trials), >= 2.0 s, force plates valid on >= 50% of frames; up to 4 trials per subject, up to 40 trials, as many subjects as possible, rng 20261105
heldout.landmarks: No_Arm skeletons have no arm joints, so the pipeline IK cannot run; heel and toe come from the file's jointCenters (subtalar and mtp joint centres, the calcn and toes origins of the same model family), filtered and resampled as in the pipeline
heldout.bridge: on the development walking trials V3 is also computed from jointCenters; the held-out result counts only if the median absolute difference to the pipeline V3 is <= 0.02 (约定，未经推演)

gate.pass_if: held-out median walking V3 >= 0.85, and on the development trials with full dynamics recomputed: walking V3 >= 0.85, jump V3 >= 0.85, walking V1 r >= 0.9 and RMSE <= 0.15 BW
gate.pass: X4 uses the E criterion with this rule; the amendment-3 envelope thresholds are recomputed with it on the same human trials and frozen before X4 data
gate.fail: X4 primary outcome is the REBA r3 certain-acceptable share without the feasibility gate; E is reported as exploratory

x4_reporting: per method and arm, the share of frames that pass the height rule but fail the speed rule (contact lost to sliding)
